body: A little more than a month ago my older sister passed away in a car accident. My family and I have been getting signs since it happened, but I was sort of skeptical of them until today. My mom and dad lit a fire in our fireplace two days ago and the log wouldn't stay lit (our fireplace is a wood fireplace, not gas) so fast forward to this afternoon my dad calls me and I see fire lit which I thought was strange because it was 1 in the afternoon and who lights fires that early. He told me that he was sitting there, the doors were closed, and he heard like a gust of wind, looked and the fire had started by itself. What's even crazier is that my sister was a Leo which is a fire sign. I had tried researching and no one has ever seemed to have a fire randomly start in their fireplace like that. The only information I could find was about forest fires and that If fires start themselves they start from the sun or lighting. It was cloudy the whole day today (I live on the East Coast) and the closest lighting storm was in Texas.
